Guides

Tools, hygiene, and the freezer

A knife, a pot, and a fridge discipline matter more than a drawer of baby gadgets.

Findings

Most special baby tools are optional. Replace a scratched non-stick pan. Keep a separate board for raw meat. A fork mashes the first foods.
Cool fast, keep two days, reheat once. Rice is stricter: cool it within an hour and eat refrigerated rice within a day.
Freeze in portions, and do not refreeze. An ice-cube tray of unsalted sauce is more useful than a raw herb paste kept for a week.

A short kit

You can cook every recipe on this site with a knife, a cutting board, a saucepan, a frying pan with an intact surface, and either a blender or a fork. A steamer basket is pleasant. An apple grater is not safer than a cooked apple for a new eater; raw gratings are uneven and easy to inhale.

Damaged non-stick coatings are a reason to replace the pan, not a surface to keep using. Raw meat needs its own board, washed with hot water afterwards. Plastic boxes are fine if they are undamaged and used for food.

Hygiene that is specific to small children

Cool food within one to two hours, in shallow containers, and put it in the fridge. Eat refrigerated meals within two days. Reheat until steaming all the way through, stir to kill cold spots, then cool to a safe bite. Reheat only once. Food left on the child’s plate is finished; it does not go back in the pot.

Rice and other grains grow Bacillus cereus if they sit warm. Cool them within an hour and use refrigerated rice within 24 hours. Dried beans are boiled hard. Eggs for infants are cooked until the white and yolk are set. Pasteurized dairy only.

Batch cooking

Freeze extra sauce, mince, and purée in small cubes the day you cook it. Label the date. Thaw in the fridge and use within 24 hours, or thaw in the microwave and serve at once. Do not refreeze once it has been thawed.

A raw vegetable-and-herb paste held in the fridge for a week is a poor preserve. The same mixture frozen at once is a good one. Salt is not a preservative you are allowed to use here.
